title: 🛠 Creepers N' Phantom Fix 🛠
description: A datapack that fixes the annoying issues for creepers and phantoms.
body:
## Have you ever complained about creepers and phantoms being annoying, and ruining everything in your world...? 👿

_WELL... Not to worry, this datapack fixes that by solving the common complaints! 🎉_

**With this datapack installed, Creepers & Phantoms, two annoying mobs are now fixed.**

## Creepers
All Creeper fuses are extended and take longer to explode, giving you more time to kill the Creeper before it blows up your house! This preventing keyboard smashing or saving you a lot of time on builds! Also, all Creepers are now highlighted and emit smoke particles, making it easier to spot them into the world.

### Now, Creepers are now highlighted and emit smoke. Scanning all those pesky Creepers in the area!

![Now, Creepers are now highlighted and emit smoke. Scanning all those pesky creepers!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7ceb9e93ab4039f54d496a9b7985b7825082719.png)

## Phantoms
Phantoms have been completely removed from spawning in the game, and die on spawn. This removes Phantom Membrane to the game, this prevents you from repairing your Elytras, but WHO CARES? The most annoying mob has been removed!

### 📢 You don't even have to type **"/gamerule doInsomnia"** in the chatbox, or even enable it in every world you make!


Yeah! That's pretty much all that the datapack adds. You can use it in any modpack, or server! Or multiplayer world!

### _However... I do have a few rules you need to follow before installing... They're pretty easy though!_

### YOU CANNOT:
- Reupload this datapack, *if you see any duplicates... Please inform me! 🚫
- Tamper with it, or change anything with it. 🚫

### ***It is highly reccomended you increase render distance with this mod for a better scanning range of creepers.**

_(If there any bugs, 🐛 please inform me! And I will try to fix it quickly! 🔧)_

_Also... If you have any social media of some sorts, please post about it! I'd love to see the video!_

### **THIS PROJECT IS ORIGINALLY ON PLANET MINECRAFT, DOWNLOAD IT HERE:**
